performance.verdict: Five overdue SOW milestones explain why $3,597 in spend yields zero won cases.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — none completed per record.
CPL exploded 261.7% in 7 days: leads fell from 7 to 3 while spend surged 55%, pushing 7-day CPL far above the 28-day baseline of $156.38.
Google Ads spend jumped 90.17% in 7 days; top campaign alone consumed $1,437.17 of $2,536.10 28-day total, yet Google conversions show only 6 — likely pixel not wired (SOW blocker).
3-day lead signal (Sep 17–19): 2 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 14–16): 3 leads — declining inside an already thin 45-day series averaging under 1 lead/day.
GHL shows 99 opportunities created vs 23 ad-platform leads and 0 won — intake leak: contacts arrive but no appointment or close recorded in 28 days.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no budget increase until stack test and pixel wiring confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones due July 31–Aug 1 remain incomplete: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting. Google Ads is spending $2,536 over 28 days with only 6 tracked conversions, almost certainly because the pixel conversion wiring (a Month 1 blocker) was never verified. Success check: all 5 milestones marked complete in project board by 2026-09-27, with a live end-to-end lead test confirming data writes to Clio Manage.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake routing: 99 opps created, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm speed-to-lead and assignment rules are live.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 99 opportunities created in 28 days against 0 appointments booked and 0 won cases, meaning contacts are entering the pipeline but no follow-up or booking flow is closing them. Per SOW, first contact must be under 5 minutes in business hours with after-hours auto-reply. Confirm assignment rules, speed-to-lead timers, and the missed-call-text-back sequence are active. Success check: at least 1 confirmed appointment booked in GHL within 7 days of fix, verified by 2026-09-27.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget scaling; re-check CPL and lead volume in 3 days once pixel and intake fixes are in place.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL surged 261.7% week-over-week and the 3-day lead trend (2 leads, Sep 17–19) is declining. Google spend rose 90% without verified conversion tracking, making any scale decision unreliable. No budget changes are warranted until the pixel wiring and intake fixes (S1, S2) are confirmed live. Re-check on 2026-09-23: if CPL is below the 28-day baseline of $156.38 and leads are trending up over 3 days, scaling discussion can open.
